purpose: Four UI art directions for selection before production asset creation and integration.

directions.title: Warm Paw Café
directions.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity UI art direction mockup for the Godot desktop pet game Pet Da Dog, square format.
Image 1 is the existing functional Accessories UI screenshot, an edit target for UI styling only.
Primary request: replace the plain white, blocky UI styling with an inviting polished game interface in the specified art direction. Keep the same functional layout: three tabs across the top, confirmed Pets status and separate Pending at top right, instructions, a large central dog placement preview, selected accessory controls with Remove and Clear all, a Color swatch and Reset white, and six accessory catalog cards. Include generous spacing, clear hierarchy, soft rounded edges, readable dark or light typography, strong selected states, and quiet backgrounds behind artwork.
Invariant: the existing dog and all six accessory artwork images from the screenshot are protected existing game art. Preserve their appearance, pose, outlines, colors, and proportions; do not redesign, invent, replace, stylize, or recolor them. Change only the UI surrounding them. No new characters. Keep the central dog stage uncluttered.
Text: retain readable functional labels from the reference: "Accessories", "Discoveries", "Settings", "Pets: Syncing...", "Pending: 1", "Exit Game", "Safety Glasses", "Remove", "Clear all", "Color", "Reset white", "Accessories · 6", "Outfit saved". Card labels "Dragon Wing", "Fairy Wing", "Safety Glasses", "S Flower 1", "S Flower 2", "Square Charm". Keep body instructions concise and legible.
Composition: one complete straight-on app window filling the image, no desktop monitor, no perspective, no external branding, no moodboard grid, no watermark. Concept art for UI selection; crisp production-quality presentation.
Art direction: Warm Paw Café
A cozy illustrated café-inspired UI. Warm oat and peach surfaces, sage green accent tabs and buttons, cocoa brown text, honey highlights. Rounded padded panels, subtle linen/paper grain, soft warm shadows and a few tiny hand-drawn paw/heart details at the outer margins. Active Accessories tab has a sage cushion shape. Dog preview is a calm oat mat with a gentle warm vignette. Catalog tiles feel like soft fabric tags with small curved corners and raised edges, rather than white rectangles. Charming, mature, welcoming and restrained; no food props.

Art direction: Sticker Club
A playful premium sticker-book UI. Dusty lavender backdrop, butter-yellow selected tab, coral highlights, mint secondary controls, deep plum text. Organic rounded paper panels and plush pill controls, thick but tasteful sticker outlines, soft layered paper shadows, sparse tiny confetti and star doodles confined to margins. Dog preview is a calm lavender/cream sticker sheet. Catalog cards feel like removable rounded sticker tabs; selected glasses card uses a butter-yellow frame and a small equipped badge. Cheerful and tactile, not childish clutter, no harsh neon colors.

Art direction: Moonlit Meadow
A calm magical evening UI, rich dark direction. Deep plum/navy base, dusty lavender panels, muted teal active accents, small warm gold highlights and pale cream text. Soft luminous curved borders, rounded pill tabs, a restrained scattering of tiny stars at outer edges and delicate leaf silhouettes. Dog preview has a quiet softly shaded dark meadow-like stage with no objects behind the dog. Catalog cards are velvety rounded lavender wells with gentle rim lighting; selected one is teal/gold. Cozy night mood, exceptionally readable, no cyberpunk neon, no glass dashboard aesthetic.

Art direction: Woodland Workshop
A handcrafted woodland UI. Moss and sage green framing, parchment cream content surfaces, pine green text, terracotta accents, small muted brass details. Light painted foliage only at outer corners, softly worn curved wooden borders and stitched fabric tabs, tactile illustrated buttons with gentle asymmetry. Dog preview is a quiet parchment field framed by subtle curved wood. Catalog cards are small rounded paper labels mounted on a soft sage tray, selected card uses terracotta stitching. Warm earthy storybook craftsmanship, polished and legible, no realistic scenery and no added animals.
